scenes.title: She Was Truly Someone Special
scenes.summary: Outside Kuroki's hospital room as cameras flash downstairs, Kawada blames himself for turning Kuroki into merchandise when Muranishi was arrested overseas, and her friend reminds him that Kuroki chose that path herself.

scenes.title: Don't Kill Your Own Heart
scenes.summary: Driving Muranishi to a sea cliff at dawn, Toshi asks him to jump and points a pistol at him; Muranishi begs Toshi not to murder his own loving heart over mere scraps of paper and pitches exporting Japanese adult video to the world.

scenes.title: Even So, I Am Alive!
scenes.summary: Trembling before Toshi's gun, Muranishi proclaims an inclusive adult version of "We Are the World" where overflowing ideas never end; when Toshi fires wide and drives away, Muranishi laughs and shouts to the sky that he is alive.

scenes.title: Don't Kill Him, Toshi
scenes.summary: Inside his syndicate office, Furuya complains about his wounded leg before Toshi storms in alone, whispering Muranishi's words to himself as he shoots Furuya dead and is fatally stabbed by Furuya's men.

scenes.title: Please Be Happy Without Fail
scenes.summary: As television news reports Furuya's shooting death, the betrayed actress visits the junior director with her credit-union fiancé to return the thirty million yen; holding back tears until she leaves, he wishes her lasting happiness.

scenes.title: Who Is Kaoru Kuroki?
scenes.summary: Leaving the hospital on crutches, Kuroki stuns reporters by asking "Who is Kaoru Kuroki?", tells her friend in the taxi that the persona has faded away day by day, and rides home with her mother Kayo.
scenes.location: hospital lobby, taxi, and family car

scenes.title: Nothing Was a Mistake, Everything Is Right
scenes.summary: Harassed at her convenience store job because of her adult video past, the young former actress vents to a homeless Muranishi, who tells her that as long as she is alive everything is the right answer.

scenes.title: Cleaning Out Our Own Dirt First
scenes.summary: Planning to cultivate Furuya's deputy as his next underworld informant, Detective Takei brings him into headquarters—only to be arrested himself for bribery as police brass vow to purge internal corruption first.

scenes.title: Let's Liven Up the Adult Industry
scenes.summary: Delighted by Kawada and the junior director's quirky, ultra-long video titles about everyday desire, the chain Proprietor praises their originality and mentions a rumor he heard about Muranishi's whereabouts.

scenes.title: Toshi Killed Furuya
scenes.summary: Tracking Muranishi down at a seaside stall, Kawada tells him that Toshi stormed Furuya's office alone and gave his own life to save Muranishi—urging the grieving director to live true to the filmmaker Toshi loved.

scenes.title: Not My Doing, It Is the Stone's Will
scenes.summary: Refusing to lend Muranishi money because Toshi would never forgive it, Kawada challenges the former salesman to sell him an ordinary beach stone—reigniting Muranishi's unstoppable sales pitch.

scenes.title: Just Be the Way You Are
scenes.summary: By 1994, a new generation of directors shoots respectfully and creatively—rewriting scenes around a newcomer's comfort—while Muranishi works odd jobs on television to support his young family.

scenes.title: If You Want to Die, Look Down
scenes.summary: When a low-budget producer flees with the studio money and cancels a shoot, Muranishi strips down to his white briefs, hijacks the camera crew into filming right on the street, and shouts his defiant creed as police chase him.
scenes.location: backstage dressing room and city street
